'''Anders Hagfeldt''' (born 16 February 1964) is a Swedish [[material scientist]]. Since 2021 he has been [[vice-chancellor]] of [[Uppsala University]], where he is a professor of [[physical chemistry]] and where he received his [[PhD]] in 1993.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Anders Hagfeldt - Uppsala University |url=https://www.uu.se/en/contact-and-organisation/staff?query=XX3873 |access-date=2024-05-13 |website=www.uu.se |language=en}}</ref><ref name=uu>{{Cite web |date=2020-06-17 |title=Anders Hagfeldt proposed as new Vice-Chancellor of Uppsala University - Uppsala University |url=https://www.uu.se/en/news/2020/2020-06-17-anders-hagfeldt-proposed-as-new-vice-chancellor-of-uppsala-university |access-date=2024-05-13 |website=www.uu.se |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Anders Hagfeldt |url=https://www.the-guild.eu/about/governance/anders-hagfeldt.html |website=The Guild}}</ref>

His [[h-index|''h''-index]] – according to [[Scopus]] – is 157, based on 677 published documents.{{r|scopus}} ''[[Times Higher Education]]'' listed him as the 46th top material scientist of the past decade.{{cn|date=May 2024}} His memberships include the [[European Academy of Sciences and Arts]], the [[Royal Society of Sciences in Uppsala]], the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Engineering Sciences]] and the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]]. He has an [[honorary doctorate]] from the [[Université Paris Diderot]] and is a ''professeur honoraire'' of the [[École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne]] in Switzerland.<ref name=uu />

He is deputy [[editor-in-chief]] of the ''[[Journal of Materials Chemistry A]].''<ref>{{Cite web |title=Journal_of_materials_chemistry_a_editorial board members |url=http://www.rsc.org/journals-books-databases/about-journals/journal-of-materials-chemistry-a/editorial-board-members/}}</ref> 

He received the [[Björkén Prize]] in 2016.<ref>{{cite web |title=Björkén Prize |url=https://physics.uu.se/aboutus/prizes--distinctions-and-honorary-tasks/the-bjork-n-prize/ |access-date=October 1, 2020 |website=Uppsala University, Department of Physics and Astronomy}}</ref>

In September 2023 he was cleared in a research misconduct case.{{cn|date=May 2024}}
